tasks.short: Adhere to health, safety and environmental regulations, policies and procedures.

steps.what: Find and check the current approved health, safety and environmental procedure applicable to this production activity
Apply the procedure to actual work, follow precautions and stop or seek clarification on unsafe or uncertain conditions
outputs: actual compliant actions and observed exceptions

steps.what: Complete and check the required actual compliance checklist or exception note v1
inputs: actual compliant actions and observed exceptions

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual compliance note v1 in the same record

tasks.design: Configure approved procedure tags and activity links in {DOCS}, retaining the procedure owner's version and applicability. Physical compliance and actual checklist content stay human; the technician checks the completed record before its separate {OPS_SYSTEM} save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure lookup can depend on knowing the right document name.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata and approved activity links can reduce search.
tasks.still_hard: Procedures do not settle every unsafe real-world condition.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when actual work does not fit the approved method and stop.
tasks.altitude: Less document search; personal compliance duties remain.

reach.role: Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors
reach.learn: Escalate ambiguity with actual activity and version context.

evidence.claim: Native document metadata can reduce retrieval of an approved procedure; it does not determine compliance.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's own adherence and existing required evidence, not statutory interpretation or a new worker-monitoring service. Shares are provisional, not measured.

The procedure owner supplies approved version, effective dates, activity and site tags; the technician supplies the actual activity, observations and exception facts manually. Missing applicability is resolved with the owner rather than inferred.
Try native configuration first; no runtime saving or same-save saving. New incident reporting or external filing, if required, needs separate checked and gated actions.
unknowns: Existing procedure tags and real lookup time
Which activities require an actual compliance checklist
research_questions: Can workers reliably locate the applicable approved procedure using existing metadata?

already_counted.description: Actual checklist content and final check.

incremental.description: Confirm activity links after procedure changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked actual compliance note v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Where procedure search occupies the provisional 15 hours, native links remove 4.5 hours less 0.5 upkeep. Actual adherence and compliance evidence remain full; an already linked library gives no gross gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect current production status and compare recorded measures with the approved process limits
Oversee and physically inspect the actual production process, obtain missing observations and judge deviations with operators
Write and check the actual production inspection record v1 using observed facts and existing batch identifiers
Save the exact checked actual inspection record v1 in the same production record

tasks.design: Configure a native {OPS_SYSTEM} inspection view showing existing measures beside approved limits, and reuse batch identifiers in the inspection form. The technician performs the physical inspection, enters actual observations and checks their meaning; there is no automatic machine adjustment or inferred completion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recorded production measures and inspection form headers can require repeated navigation and entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native limit views and linked batch forms can remove that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected process behaviour, measurement reliability and operator context require on-site judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a physical deviation that the recorded measures miss.
tasks.altitude: Fewer reference lookups and header entries during the same inspections.

reach.learn: Preserve actual operating conditions and source timestamps.

evidence.claim: Native production views and related-record fields can reduce navigation and header re-entry.

assumptions: Boundary covers oversight, physical inspection and its actual record. Equipment changes and formal defect escalations require their own approved actions; no saving for them is included. Shares are provisional.

The existing production system receives actual batch id, measurement value, unit and timestamp from existing instruments or operators; process engineering supplies approved limits and versions. The technician manually obtains missing measures and writes actual findings; the design assumes no new telemetry.

Test native configuration before code. All actual observation and substantive record content stay full; the 10% record reduction is only repeated batch headers. Allocate overlap with separate compliance inspections once.
unknowns: Coverage of reliable existing production measures
Whether the form already carries batch identifiers
research_questions: Which reference and header fields are currently re-entered by the technician?

already_counted.description: Actual findings and final inspection-record check.

incremental.description: Maintain displayed limits and header mapping after process revisions.

approvals.approved_version: checked actual inspection record v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The provisional native-view case removes 5 hours of lookup and 2.1 of header entry, less 1 upkeep hour. Low case has few duplicate headers; all physical inspection and same-system save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify opportunities to improve automation-equipment quality, cost or efficiency.

steps.what: Gather actual automation-equipment downtime, rejects, cycle and cost evidence and compare like operating conditions
Observe actual automation equipment and discuss causes and constraints with operators
Identify and assess technically credible quality, cost or efficiency opportunities for the actual automation equipment
Write and check the final opportunity note v1 with evidence, uncertainties and proposed next investigation
Save the exact checked opportunity note v1 in the same document store

tasks.design: Configure a native {OPS_SYSTEM} equipment comparison export or existing {SPREADSHEET} query to group recorded downtime, rejects and cycle data with explicit units and denominators. The technician checks the tables, observes equipment and judges opportunities; the tool does not infer root causes or claim savings from unmeasured improvements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Like-for-like comparisons can require repeating filters and formulas across equipment records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and refreshable spreadsheet queries can repeat a specified comparison.
tasks.still_hard: Correlation does not establish a fix, and recorded reasons can be wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Connect actual machine behaviour to a technically credible investigation.

ambition.what: Choose the next equipment investigation using a refreshed, checked comparison after each reviewed production period.

tasks.altitude: Less table assembly; more time observing the cause behind an apparent loss, without approval rights for changes.

reach.learn: Present measured constraints and uncertainty before suggesting a modification.

evidence.claim: Native exports and spreadsheet queries can repeat specified equipment comparisons; root-cause judgement stays human.

assumptions: Boundary is identifying an opportunity, not implementing a modification or guaranteeing a business benefit. Shares are provisional.

Existing production records are produced by operators or instruments: equipment id, operating period, runtime, downtime duration/reason, output, rejects, cycle unit and product/setup id. Finance supplies approved cost rates and validity. Missing actual fields require manual collection and validation at full effort, not assumed zero-cost tags.
Test native reporting first. Remaining comparison time includes unit, denominator, source and outlier checks. No machine runtime, expected production or unproved improvement benefit is credited.
unknowns: Completeness and comparability of actual equipment records
Whether cost rates and reason codes are maintained
research_questions: Can the installed reporting tool make the comparison with visible missing-data counts?

already_counted.description: Source, denominator, unit and outlier checks in equipment comparison.

incremental.description: Maintain comparison definitions as products and reason codes change.

approvals.approved_version: checked opportunity note v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: With usable existing equipment records, repeatable comparisons remove 12.6 of the provisional 28 assembly hours, less 1.5 upkeep. Sparse records leave less assembly to remove; observation, technical assessment, note writing and save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop or implement programs addressing production, materials, safety or quality problems.

steps.what: Investigate the actual production, materials, safety or quality problem and define constraints and intended outcomes
Develop the technical improvement program, responsibilities and test criteria from the actual problem
Check the completed program v1 against engineering direction, actual constraints and permitted implementation scope
Save the exact checked permitted improvement program v1 in the same project record
Implement the exact checked permitted program v1 within existing delegated scope and observe actual results
Record and check actual implementation outcomes and deviations after the work in final outcome note v1
Save the exact checked actual outcome note v1 in the same project record

tasks.design: Configure an existing {PROJECT} program template with the required headings, responsibilities and test-result fields, linked to {DOCS}. Only repeated layout and heading work shrinks; the technician develops the technical content, checks the completed permitted version, implements it manually and records actual outcomes afterwards.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated program formatting can obscure missing test criteria and responsibilities.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project templates can provide the structure without generating technical decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Safe technical changes, delegated scope and actual verification require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a sound intervention and recognise when implementation must stop.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less program formatting; technical development and implementation remain human.

reach.learn: Supply actual constraints and explicit test criteria.

evidence.claim: Native project templates can remove repeated document structure work without authoring a technical program.

assumptions: Boundary covers technician-led programs within already delegated scope. Formal engineering approvals beyond that scope remain required and unchanged; the design grants none. Shares are provisional, not measured.

The technician produces actual problem facts, intended actions, responsibilities and test criteria; engineering supplies direction and permitted scope. Missing facts are collected manually before drafting. Actual implementation results are captured by the technician after execution, never populated from the plan.

Try native templates first. Only 3 of 30 program-development hours are provisional repeated formatting; content, check, actual implementation, outcome record and same-system saves stay full. Any distinct notices or change deployments require separate gates if included locally.
unknowns: Delegated program scope and required engineering review
research_questions: Does a native template remove layout work without adding outcome-entry burden?

already_counted.description: Final technical and scope check of the completed program.
Actual post-implementation outcome capture and check.

incremental.description: Maintain program template headings when the approved method changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked permitted improvement program v1; edits void approval
checked permitted improvement program v1 and exact delegated implementation scope; changes require recheck
checked actual outcome note v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeated native template removes only 3 formatting hours per 100 program hours, less 0.5 upkeep. Technical design, final check, physical implementation and actual outcome capture remain full; an existing equivalent template gives no gross return.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Fewer repeated reference searches and comparison tables; technical judgement and actual production work remain central.
reach: Bring checked evidence and constraints to engineering colleagues.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who can investigate a machine loss using current evidence without expanding safety or change authority.
